definition: Catalog declares DUPLICATE / ALREADY_COVERED / REPEAT_CANONICAL for an ID that re-exposes the same goal as a canonical capability. Live execution under the duplicate ID must return a goal-equivalent, user-ready payload — not a generic handler and not a different capability's goal.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog proof: CAP646_GAP_MATRIX or CAP646_CATALOG entry with DUPLICATE/ALREADY_COVERED/REPEAT_CANONICAL or explicit duplicate_of canonical ID
Live execution under the duplicate ID returns success=true with goal-specific surface (not GENERIC_SURFACES)
Payload includes catalog_link.duplicate_of and classification REUSED-LINK when served via dedicated spine
Canonical target ID is itself PRODUCTION-ALIGNED before REUSED-LINK closure is accepted

counting_rules.reused_link_accepted: Counts as covered/ready for the duplicate ID goal — not independent new build
counting_rules.no_826_reduction: 826 total is not reduced; report separates independent PRODUCTION-ALIGNED vs REUSED-LINK covered
